title: Kampffelder und Fundmarken
prompt: Edit the supplied transparent asset atlas with one precise camera correction. Keep the EXACT same 3 columns by 3 rows and all nine existing assets and their slot order. Change ONLY the THREE TERRAIN TILES in the TOP ROW: they must be near-top-down, FRONT-ALIGNED SQUARE tiles with horizontal top and bottom edges and vertical left and right edges, not diamond-shaped isometric tiles. Match the square cell camera of reference 2. A small exposed earthen front lip is fine for 3D depth, but each grass/cleared/rocky top surface must read as a square cell that can sit edge-to-edge in an original 10x10 rectangular combat grid. Keep the other six item markers unchanged in their current slots. Preserve size and detail, warm light, palette, transparent canvas and gutters, no labels. Maintain alpha background, clean edges with no red chroma fringes or stray pixels. No new items or silhouettes.
originalPrompt:
Production artwork asset atlas for Scruffy Colony, following the user's chosen tactile Diorama art direction in the provided references. The reference supplies believable miniature proportions, finely sculpted grass/soil edges, hand crafted wood, quiet cream parchment, petrol enamel, warm upper-left natural lantern light, beautiful painterly 3D finish. Generate at the highest native resolution available, balanced useful detail, cohesive perspective across objects, definitely not flat SVG vector icons. This is an ASSET SHEET, not a screenshot or marketing poster. No typography, no labels, no numerals, no watermarks, no UI copy. Every requested object is inside its own exact equal-sized atlas cell, generous clear TRANSPARENT gutters, nothing crossing between cells. Outside all isolated objects the PNG must have real alpha transparency, not a checkerboard drawn into it. Preserve separation and full objects. No people, no monsters, no new characters. No invented gameplay, prices, controls or balance.
EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, nine separate assets. Read left-to-right top-to-bottom in this exact order. Row1: (1) a bare raised square grass/earth terrain tile, slightly bevelled mossy edge, NO item on it; (2) a pale stone cleared tile of the same shape and camera, NO checkmark or glyph, those will be semantic overlays; (3) a neutral rocky/earth tile of the same shape and camera, NO additional item. Row2: (4) one miniature conifer/tree on a tiny mossy root footprint, no square terrain tile; (5) a small wicker basket of red apples as Food loot marker, no terrain tile; (6) one compact pile of slate/iron ore as Metal marker, no terrain tile. Row3: (7) a closed leather-bound research book with tiny brass clasps, NO written symbol; (8) a tied wrapped gift parcel with red ribbon; (9) a small carved wooden unpainted bust silhouette on a base to represent the existing unlock/worker marker, a generic abstract pawn rather than a new creature. Match objects and tiles from reference1 but isolate them for semantic 10x10 grid rendering. The bare terrain cells must remain reusable, their decoration never implies a gameplay state. All nine equal slots, on alpha, strong consistent silhouettes. No written words or checkmarks.
